states.question: I can help you sort this out one step at a time. What is the property address?
Thank you. Are you the owner of the home?
Thanks for telling me. Is the owner a family member, and are they living?
Good. Do you live in this home as your primary residence — the place you live most of the year?
What city is the property in?
Have you received a tax notice or letter about this property?
What words do you see on the notice — delinquent, forfeiture, show cause, foreclosure, court hearing, or something else?
This may be time-sensitive, so I want to be careful. Does the notice list a deadline or hearing date?
What year or years are listed as delinquent? For example, 2023, 2024, or more than one year.
Do you know if the home has a Principal Residence Exemption, also called PRE or homestead?
Have you already applied for HOPE, PAYS, IRSPA, or a Treasurer payment plan?
Are you able to make any payment right now, even a small first payment?
Is there a hardship affecting payment, like fixed income, job loss, medical bills, disability, or a recent family change?
I can help with the paperwork. Do you have documents like ID, proof of residence, proof of income, or the tax notice available?
Would you like a person to review this with you before you submit anything?

outcomes.path_label: Urgent review for deadline or hearing
outcomes.next_step: Create a human review task now, capture the notice type and deadline, and help the resident upload or describe the notice before ending the session.

outcomes.path_label: Elevated review for unclear time-sensitive notice
outcomes.next_step: Flag the case for review, ask the resident to upload or read the notice, and continue collecting owner-occupant and delinquency facts.

outcomes.path_label: Legal aid referral for title, probate, or ownership issue
outcomes.next_step: Connect the resident with legal aid or specialist review for the title issue, then revisit tax relief or payment-plan options once ownership is clear.

outcomes.path_label: Occupant options when resident is not on title
outcomes.next_step: Route to a specialist to review occupant options and whether the resident can help the owner complete tax-relief or payment-plan steps.
Help the resident confirm the balance and choose the county payment route. Do not ask for real bank or card numbers in the demo.

outcomes.path_label: Resident assistance path with human review
outcomes.next_step: Give the resident a document checklist, create a follow-up task, and identify whether the next likely step is HOPE/PAYS, Treasurer payment plan, IRSPA/REGSPA review, DOOE review, or partner help.
Give the resident the next step and document checklist, then offer to save progress or schedule a callback if they get stuck.
